title: Perceived value and price worthiness
summary: Feedback on whether the G70 is worth its price is mostly ambiguous in these samples, with one clear positive comment and several fragments that mention worth or payment without enough context for a reliable sentiment reading.

positive.summary: One review clearly says the car’s comfort makes it feel worth the price.

undetermined.summary: Several fragments mention worth, cost, payments, tech, or interior value, but the limited wording makes their sentiment unclear or inconsistently labeled.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, which limits confidence in summarizing value sentiment.
Some undetermined examples appear to contain opinionated wording, but the provided sentiment assignments must be preserved.
The topic is narrowly supported by short fragments, so examples are insufficient to draw broader conclusions about price satisfaction.
